54000.description:
Office worker Leon has just been thrust into an otome game where women hold all the power. His only tool for survival is the knowledge gained from playing this game in his past life. But after befriending the heroine and villainess, and making a name for himself, his choices begin to warp the story beyond what he knows. Now, Leon is dragged into a conspiracy that could shake the entire kingdom.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

54013.description:
2022 marks the 30th anniversary of the original Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki OVA series and to celebrate, a brand new Tenchi Muyo! GXP anime series was announced.

The new series, titled Tenchi Muyo! GXP Paradise Beginnings Arc, connects the 4th and 5th seasons of the series and will serve as an introduction to the Paradise War through the eyes of Seina Yamada.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

54015.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Peperoncino (ぺぺろんちーの).

In this world, there are evil monsters called goblins. They are lowly demons that can be found everywhere......, at least that's how they are perceived by humans. They attack people, kidnap women, rape them, impregnate them, and reproduce repeatedly.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

54018.description:
A young manga artist whose inspiration gradually runs out on the road to creation accidentally adopts two pets when he goes out to find inspiration. The cat is named Huanghuang, and the dog is named Bazahei. Although the two little guys often brought a lot of trouble to the teenager, they also gained two pieces of companionship and love at the same time. Although they are a cat and a dog, the teenager knows that they are family. And then, the noisy but warm and happy life of the teenager began.

(Source: bilibili.tv)

54027.description:
This work is based on 15 years of entries in the diary that I’ve kept since age eight. Through creating this work I was searching for freedom from my preconceptions about animation and myself.

1st year work 2021, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)

54028.description:
"Turkey" is a bowling term for scoring three consecutive strikes.

Mai, a second-year student and captain of the Ikkokukan High School Bowling Club, is a genius who can't seem to win a match. Whenever she scores a Turkey, she mysteriously follows it up with an unyielding split—the Snake Eyes.

One day, Rina, the club’s only first-year member, confronts her "You’re doing it on purpose, aren’t you?"

"You’re running away from winning. But I want to win. If you have no intention of winning, I’ll quit."

(Source: Official Site)

streamingEpisodes.title: Episode 3 - Lean on Your Balance Line
Episode 1 - Knock Down the Snake Eyes!

54029.description:
Wu Liuqi originally lived a carefree life on Xiaoji Island, but his identity remained a mystery because of amnesia. As an outsider arrives and recognizes Wu Liuqi, various conspiracies begin to envelop the Island. In order to protect his friends and their home, Wu Liuqi decides to return to Xuanwu to face his destiny.

(Source: bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xi Xing Ji: Anying Mo Cheng

54035.description:
On this wintry day, I'll stay with everyone at Golden Courtyard to do adorable things and create special memories, and then we'll embrace the new year in our unique way. Haha, does this sound ceremonious? After all, I want to create more such wonderful memories with every one of you, because I love you all ♪

(Source: Honkai Impact 3rd Official Youtube Channel)

54038.description: A visual poem that embodies the spirit of a 'wall' that cannot move even a little, is left in the same place and sees off those who are passing by, rotting away in solitude, and yet continues to live on.

54040.description:
The time is a future where humans have moved their residence to the moon.... In the lunar colony, a game has become very popular. The name of the game is "Run for the Money." It is an entertainment survival game in which fugitives are released into a limited area, and if they can escape from the pursuing android "hunters" until the time limit counts down to zero, they can win a large prize. Some dream of getting rich, while others challenge themselves to test their strength in "Run for the Money."

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Run for Money: The Great Mission

title.native: 逃走中 グレートミッション

54041.description:
Konoha Akisato is an illustrator that loves beautiful girls and bishojo games. Her dream is to become a super-popular illustrator, so she is working hard at a bishojo game production company, but reality isn't that kind... With the golden age of social network games in full force, Konoha's company isn't doing well, and she works as a sub illustrator, spending her days painting the backs of random background characters.

One day, the owner of a game shop gives her a classic bishojo game. With all her excitement over the golden age of bishojo games, she opens the package to "Dokyusei," and is enveloped by a bright light. Konoha then realizes that she just traveled back in time!

She ends up in the year 1992! It's the dawn of the bishojo game era! Konoha ends up working at a company called Alcohol Soft. Will she be able to think about, draw, and create all the beautiful girls she’s ever wanted?!

A story about a girl and her overwhelming love for beautiful girls—"Now, let's begin!"

(Source: Crunchyroll)

54042.description:
Ritsuka Fujimaru is humanity's last Master. Restoring humanity would have been impossible without him. However, even he has a shortcoming: he is honest to a fault! This FGO slapstick anime shows Fujimaru's naive questions throwing the Heroic Spirits into turmoil, and all in the original manga's surreal tone.

(Source: Aniplex of America)
